Four months ago offered his blood for a poor re- ligious. By mistake the doctor in charge took 99% instead of 33, in consequence .. could not stand up after said transfusion and had to stay four months in bed. He is a specialist. He does not profess any religious denom ....... Is now practicing medicine again but is weak.
